remarks: Spacious 1 Bedroom condo, freshly painted with new flooring! Located in the heart of Stamford with plenty of sunshine and gorgeous views from your large private balcony. Beautiful lobby, courtyard and lush gardens, great convenient location. Walk to Stamford Downtown where all the action is, enjoy all the night life, great restaurants and events, library, mall, shops , UCONN, enjoy Stamford beaches. Easy access to public transportation, I-95 and N.Y. Metro Train. 1 hour to N.Y.C. Heat, Hot Water, Cooking Gas, Gym, and 1 Assigned Parking space ALL INCLUDED. Tenant pays credit check, move-in and Move out fee $250. Laundry and Gym in the lower level. Don't wait, this beauty will be gone quick! Good credit and references required. Available Nov 1.
